guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation page with data tables that do not overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing; give scrollable treatment (overflow:auto) to long unbreakable content; wrap wide tables rather than letting them force page overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} around the doc-table, overflow-wrap:anywhere on table cells, h1 and lede.
